## Release summary

Write factual, user-facing release notes in both languages. Be specific about what changed and why. For documentation-only or internal-only changes, say that no user-facing behavior changed and describe the repository change without presenting it as a feature. Use an explicit “not applicable” statement with a reason when a section does not apply. Do not claim checks that were not run.

<!-- release-summary:start -->
## English

### Highlights
<!-- What changed? For docs-only/internal-only work, state that clearly. -->

### Behavior and why
<!-- Describe changed user behavior and its reason, or state that behavior did not change. -->

### How to use
<!-- Give user steps when relevant, otherwise explain why no action applies. -->

### Compatibility / migration
<!-- Describe compatibility, migration, or explicitly state that none is needed. -->

### Verification
<!-- Name checks that actually passed and relevant evidence. -->

### Not run / known limitations
<!-- State checks not run and limitations that remain. -->
